targets.title: The Triangulum Galaxy
targets.what: The third largest galaxy of our local group, after Andromeda and the Milky Way, seen nearly face on.

targets.title: Almach
targets.sub: Gamma Andromedae, a gold and blue double star
targets.what: Two stars that look like one to the eye. A telescope splits them into a gold star and a smaller blue one.

targets.title: NGC 891
targets.sub: A spiral galaxy seen edge on, in Andromeda
targets.what: A galaxy much like our own, seen exactly from the side, with a dark lane of dust down its middle.

targets.title: Messier 77
targets.sub: A spiral galaxy with a brilliant core, in Cetus
targets.what: A galaxy whose centre outshines the rest of it: gas falling toward a giant black hole there glows as it goes.

targets.title: NGC 1535
targets.sub: A small blue planetary nebula in Eridanus
targets.what: The shell a dying star has thrown off, lit by the hot core it left behind.

targets.title: The Crab Nebula
targets.sub: Messier 1, the remains of a star that exploded
targets.what: What is left of a star whose explosion was seen from Earth in the year 1054, still spreading outward.

targets.title: Messier 78
targets.sub: A cloud of dust lit by young stars, in Orion
targets.what: Dust that does not glow by itself: it shines blue with the light of the young stars inside it.

targets.title: Hubble's Variable Nebula
targets.sub: NGC 2261, a fan of dust lit by one young star, in Monoceros
targets.what: A small fan of dust lit by a single young star. Shadows cast near the star change its look over weeks.

targets.title: NGC 2392
targets.what: A bright, compact shell of gas around a dying star, with a second, fainter shell around the first.

targets.title: NGC 2419
targets.sub: A globular cluster far out in the galaxy's halo, in Lynx
targets.what: A ball of hundreds of thousands of old stars, so far from the centre of the Milky Way that it was once thought to be adrift between galaxies.

targets.title: The Cigar Galaxy
targets.what: A galaxy seen from the side that is making new stars at a furious rate after a close pass by its neighbour.
